From github: https://github.com/mozilla-mobile/fenix/issues/15113.
What is the user problem or growth opportunity you want to see solved?
Currently deleting all browsing history won't delete logins. Since logins do have website information, this might leak private data. It would be great if we had a logins option in delete browsing data
How do you know that this problem exists today? Why is this important?
As a user, I want to be able to delete all user data from within the app, or on a granular scale
Who will benefit from it?
People who frequently delete browsing data

This issue is marked as "done" here but i still can't find the option to delete all saved logins/passwords on Android for Firefox 🤔
Am i missing domething ?

Comment 2

This issue is marked as "done" here
Where do you see a "done"? This ticket is still open.
2cqamuqy7
Comment 3

Oh my bad, i probably misunderstood the status change "moved from to do to done on Jan 25" here https://github.com/mozilla-mobile/fenix/issues/15113
Thanks for letting me know the issue is still open, deleting 3000 entries one by one will make my day 😁
I thought there could be a turnaroung to this issue by sync my mozilla account on a desktop device (with pwd sync), and then delete all logins at once there at account level but this does not work as expected. On the same Mozilla account fully sync, my saved logins arte empty on desktop but still there on Android, even after reinstalling completely the Android app (as if there was a second hidden logins table somewhere that sync only with mobile). I don't know if this could be considered as a distinct issue or if it is a "feature".
Mark Hammond [:markh] [:mhammond]
Comment 4

2 years ago
This should be a distinct issue - what you described should work. The about sync addon for Desktop will help you understand whether your desktop actually deleted them via Sync or not which might help us track this down.
